verdict: The proposal provides a strong visual hierarchy and clear patterns for handling read-only and degraded states.
summary: Evaluated visual state matrix, component reuse, Syncing placement in detail views, disabled approval visual coherence, and report payload indicator specificity. The proposal addresses previous UI concerns effectively by specifying stable slots for syncing and indicators, preventing layout shifts.

non_blocking_issues.title: Approval Banner Contrast
non_blocking_issues.description: The diagnostic banner for disabled approvals needs clear visual distinction from primary error alerts to avoid alarm fatigue.

non_blocking_issues.title: Syncing Indicator Motion
non_blocking_issues.description: The syncing indicator in fixed transparent slots must have subtle motion so as not to distract from the static read surfaces.

non_blocking_issues.title: First-run Banner Dismissal
non_blocking_issues.description: First-run orientation banner on Runs Home needs a clear dismissal affordance that maintains visual balance with the header.

suggestions.title: Consistent Empty States
suggestions.description: Define standard empty states for the reports list when no metadata is available yet.

suggestions.title: Accessibility Contrast
suggestions.description: Ensure the 'Unavailable' report payload indicator symbol has sufficient contrast if rendered in a disabled or tertiary color.

suggestions.title: Terminal Callout Styling
suggestions.description: For the terminal-styled callout in approval diagnostics, match the monospace typography size to the surrounding body text to maintain density.

assumptions: SF Symbols are available and consistent across the macOS deployment target.
The 96-point trailing payload-status slot does not break responsive layout on smaller window sizes.
